title: episodic-chronicle.md runtime body-structure contract
description: Hook-consumable runtime artifact for the curated episodic tier. Append-only newest-first no-LLM session chronicle, one row per session, placed FLAT in the memory dir beside MEMORY.md. Supersedes the prior per-episode memory producer. Authored by hooks/session-episode-write.sh at SessionEnd; maintained by skills/librarian/capabilities/chronicle-index.sh at session-close.
design_source: Curated episodic-tier session chronicle; supersedes the prior per-episode memory producer.

_design_notes.consumer: hooks/session-episode-write.sh (SessionEnd producer — newest-first row PREPEND + the MEMORY.md ## Episodic pointer line) + skills/librarian/capabilities/chronicle-index.sh (session-close maintainer — pointer-metadata refresh + 50KB rotation + one-line-summary backfill)
_design_notes.runtime_generated: This file is RUNTIME-GENERATED in each adopter's memory dir. It is NOT a foundation-manifest files[] member; only this contract + the chronicle-index capability are manifest-managed.
_design_notes.orphan_adder_self_immunization: The MEMORY.md ## Episodic pointer line embeds the literal substring `episodic-chronicle.md`, so the orphan-adder in hooks/memory-consolidation-run.sh (its per-file basename substring grep) reads the chronicle as already-indexed and skips it with zero new skip-code (the file is self-immunizing by construction).
_design_notes.staleness_skip: The chronicle carries `type: episodic` frontmatter, so the staleness scan skips it for re-validation (the memory-consolidation-run scan; episodic never decays).
_design_notes.evolution_protocol: Append-only; historical rows never edited in place except the one-line-summary backfill of the just-closed-session row (placeholder -> harvested close-out one-liner, no-LLM). R-37 documentary lockstep with schemas/memory-schema.json body_conventions.episodic_chronicle_row + episodic_chronicle_optional_slots — the append-only invariant is the lockstep record, NOT a write-time DENY.

append_only_rationale: One harvested no-LLM row per session. Historical rows are an immutable witnessed skeleton of the session arc. The sole in-place mutation is the one-line-summary backfill of the most-recent row by chronicle-index.
newest_first_rationale: Repository convention — newest row PREPENDS at top (under the header block); pre-existing rows shift downward without modification, so the last N sessions are read first.
section_schema:
## <YYYY-MM-DD> — <git-slug>
- slots: \{handoff: (true|false), checkpoint: (true|false), claude_mem: (true|false)\}
- \*\*Anchor:\*\* .*
- \*\*Touched:\*\* touched: [0-9]+ file\(s\) on .*
- \*\*Next session:\*\* .*
- \*\*Summary:\*\* .*
- \*\*handoff:\*\* .*
- \*\*checkpoint:\*\* .*
- \*\*claude-mem:\*\* .*

row_fields.anchor: cwd->git-slug (the hooks/lib/paths.sh project-slug resolver) + ISO date (date +%Y-%m-%d) + plan/phase (checkpoint.md flat scalars -> plan-path classify_plan_path -> `— none —`)
row_fields.touched: `touched: <COUNT> file(s) on <branch>` — COUNT from the registry touched_files row; branch via git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
row_fields.next_session: the verbatim `**Next session:**` line harvested no-LLM from the plan handoff/close-out
row_fields.summary: written NO-LLM at SessionEnd as the literal placeholder `— summary on review —`; chronicle-index BACKFILLS it at session-close from the just-written handoff/close-out
row_fields.slots_presence_map: frontmatter-line `slots: {handoff: bool, checkpoint: bool, claude_mem: bool}` — machine-canonical O(1) parse-free presence signal carried ALONGSIDE the inline `— none —` human render
row_fields.optional_pointer_slots: handoff.md path / checkpoint.md path / claude-mem session-summary; each emitted only after on-disk resolution; `— none —` on absence (never a dangling link). claude-mem pins content_session_id via source_session_id, never the renumberable `#S` ids
